rows.en: The Evil Grand Bandit Gang Returns!
Reports say two GM IIs are fighting each other. Head to the dead-end plaza in the northeast of Begins Cube's Central District and investigate the cause.
Help Birth by defeating White Yummies and collecting 100 medals. White Yummies seem to appear in Begins Cube's Central District.
A mysterious kaiju has appeared in Begins Cube. Go with the Ultra Warriors and investigate the dead-end plaza in the southwest of the Central District.
Maganac seems to have a request for us. Take Zeta Gundam to the quicksand-free area in the southeast of Desert Cube's Quicksand Zone.
We hear an MS is roaming Desert Cube's Wasteland Zone, searching for Zeta Gundam. Take Zeta Gundam and investigate the far end of the Emerium ore recovery area.
Something that looks like a Psycommu weapon was found in Desert Cube. Take Nu Gundam and Zeta Gundam and examine the oddly shaped treasure chest in the western Military Base.
Altron, who is acting alone, has made contact. Go with Wing Zero and investigate the cluster of small rooms in the eastern Desert Cube Military Base.
Enemies are carrying out large-scale excavation in the quicksand-free area of southern Desert Cube Quicksand Zone. Take 00 to the site and wipe them out.
An Antlar nest has appeared in Desert Cube's Ruins Zone. Go hear what Maganac has to say; he's waiting near the CB camp in the center of the Ruins Zone.
Pigmon has information for us. Take Ultraman to Maganac, who is waiting near the graveyard south of the Hideout Cube quarry.
A kaijin searching for RX is said to be in the west of Begins Cube. Take Black RX and investigate the long vertical plaza in the West District.
The O Raiser has reportedly been stolen. Take 00 and hear Maganac out; he's waiting at the Ride Gate entrance on Hideout Cube Lab B1.
Word is that Kamen Rider Gaoh is rampaging around the treasure vault on Layer 4 of Ultra Cube. Take Den-O to the scene and stop Gaoh.
Rumor has it there's a giant ice pop in Ultra Cube, so go investigate. The suspicious spot is the dead end with a treasure chest in the east of Layer 3.
There is said to be classified information about Veda. Take 00 to the small dead-end room in the southwest of Shocker Cube 1F.
Pigmon wants to talk to us again. Take Ultraman to Maganac, who is waiting near the graveyard south of the Hideout Cube quarry.
We've learned someone is searching for RX in the south of Shocker Cube 2F. Take RX and go investigate.
Word is a martial arts tournament is being held at the finals venue in the southwest of Ultra Cube Layer 2. Go there and investigate.
God Gundam asks to be taken to the reservoir in the southeast of Desert Cube's Wasteland Zone. Take God Gundam there.
A challenge letter has arrived from Masurao. Take 00 to the front of the Terminal Unit in the center of Veda Cube's Middle Layer.
Go and support Altron, who is acting alone. First, take Wing Zero to Maganac, who is waiting at the Ride Gate entrance in the Upper Layer of Veda Cube.
Shadow Moon has sent RX a challenge. Take RX and investigate the dead-end section in the west of Veda Cube's Upper Layer.
Word is someone is after the spark of the Plasma Spark. Take Mebius to the Plasma Spark pedestal on Layer 4 of Ultra Cube.
We got word that someone has made a lair inside Veda Cube. The exact location is unknown, but they seem to be operating from a control room built in the Upper Layer.
Mezool and Gamel, who should have been defeated, have been sighted. Take OOO and investigate the ring room in the southwest of Ultra Cube Layer 2.

notes.note: Component of 00 Raiser; written 'O Raiser' (Gundam Wiki: 0 Raiser).
Ice read as ice cream (Ankh's favorite in OOO); uncertain.
Bandit gang title is an approximation of the Japanese 'great robber gang'; matches row 25.
Prince of Sorrow; referent unclear (likely Shadow Moon line).

report: All 80 rows examined. Uncertain: ice cream (0.15/0.65), O Raiser, bandit gang names, Meikyo Shisui kept as romaji. Not in glossary: West District, O Raiser, Grand Bandit Gang, Sub-Quest, White Yummy, Ruins/Wasteland Zone (used in earlier slices).
